items.q: See, a choreographer such as Jack Cole, people like that, they wanted a drummer in there to play that show... Well, I did the best I could. And they kept calling me

ctx.x: A great difference. Those guys were longhair players. Me, I'm a swinger. So that's what they wanted me then to do, to boot that band, even though they were longhair men.
See, a choreographer such as Jack Cole, people like that, they wanted a drummer in there to play that show and

try to make those (cold) longhair guys swing. Well, I did the best I could. And they kept calling me and so I kept demanding more and more money. And they would give it to me. I couldn't play for cheap. Right today, I'm the same way.
